integrity: The universal half-plane obstruction is proved analytically. The baseline endemic equilibrium and quartic Routh-Hurwitz margins are independently reconstructed from the printed model and parameter values; the bundled standard-library checker reproduces those calculations. No finite memory-density sampling is used as proof of the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers a common scalar distributed-order Caputo operator with nonnegative order density supported in (0,1].
It is a local stability result and does not establish global endemic stability.
It does not cover compartment-specific distributed-order operators or orders exceeding one.
The source-specific Routh-Hurwitz certification is for the published baseline epidemiological parameter vector; changing epidemiological parameters requires a new Jacobian check.
title: A Hurwitz barrier to memory-induced instability in a distributed-order SEIRS model
